s: Dine betziat happat beshabbat ubo ch' seipim: shalosh seuddot chayyab kol adam leekol beshabbat. Veremez lazeh, sheshshalosh peamim "hayyom" neemar gabbe akilat hamman beshabbat, shenneemar "vayyomer mosheh ikluhu hayyom, ki shabbat hayyom laHashem, hayyom lo timtzauhu vego'":

Vechayyab kol adam libtzoa al shette kikkarot shelemot, echad anashim veechad nashim, usemak lezeh, shenneemar "laqetu lechem mishneh vego'". Veen tzarik sheyyibtza mishtehen, ella sheyyeechoz shettehen beyado veyibtza meachat mehen, shehare lo neemar "lechem mishneh" ella bilqita, dehaynu achiza. (Verashshay lehashmit hashsheniyya miyyado bishat habbetzia, veday bemah sheachaz shettehen bishat birkat "hammotzi"). Vetzarik libtzo min haelyona, sheen maabirin al hammitzvot. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyom hashshabbat, o belel yom tob, abal belel shabbat yesh nohagin mittaam hayyadua lahem libtzoa al hattachtona, ukede shello laabor al hammitzvot mannichin hattachtona qarob etzlam yoter mehaelyona, venimtza sheen kan maabir al hammitzva kelal, o loqechin haelyona bishat birkat "hammotzi" umannichim otah lematta ubotzein aleha:

Mitzva libtzoa beshabbat perusa gedola shettaspiq lo lekol hasseudda, mippene shennireh kimchabbeb seuddat shabbat, shechapetz leekol bah harbeh. Veap al pi shebbechol en laasot ken mippene shennireh keraabtan, mikkol maqom hoil veeno oseh ken kol yemot hachol ella beshabbat bilbad — nikkar haddabar sheeno oseh bishbil raabtanut, ella bishbil kebod hashshabbat:

En hamsubbin rashshaim litom ad sheyyitom habbotzea im hem zequqim lekikkaro, dehaynu sheen lahem lechem mishneh lipne kol echad, vehem yotzeim yede chobatam bemah sheshshomeim mimmennu birkat "hammotzi" shemmebarek al lechem mishneh, veokelim meoto lechem mishneh. Abal im yesh lechem mishneh lipne kol echad mehem, sheenam zequqim litom millechem mishneh shellepanayv — yekolim litom mimmah shellipnehem qodem shettaam hu mimmah shellepanayv:

Apillu akal adam kol mine maadannim umine tabshilin harbeh ap al pi shehem mechameshet hamminim — eno yotze yede chobat g' seuddot shechayyab adam lisod beshabbat, ad sheyyokal lechem shemmebarekin alayv "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon (veod sheiqqar seudda hu hallechem shealayv yichyeh haadam), lepi shellegabbe akilat hamman shemmimmenna lamedu g' seuddot neemar bah lechem, shenneemar "vayyomer alehem mosheh hu hallechem asher natan vego'":

Vekevan sheakal yeter meat mikkebetza — yatza yede chobato, abal kebetza bilbad niqret akilat aray, veeno yotze bah. Veyesh omerim shebbikzayit bilbad yotze yede chobato. Veyesh omerim shebbisudda shelishit en tzarik lechem kelal, veyitbaer hakkol besimman rtz"a:
Tob lebarek al b' aguddot shel hadas qodem qiddush shel layla veshel yom, ubetok seudda shelishit:

Im yesh qetzat ones shello yukal lisod ballayla — yakol lidchot hasseudda ad lemachar, sheyyokal g' seuddot bayyom. Ubilbad sheyyeqaddesh ballayla, veyokal miyyad achar haqqiddush kezayit mechameshet hamminim, o sheyyishteh od rebiit yayin, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"g. Abal im en sham ones — en laasot ken, shehare apillu mibbeod yom mitzva limnoa milleekol kede sheyyokal ballayla leteabon, kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"t:
